hook: SCP-3125 is by qntm and belongs to the Antimemetics Division stories its tags point to. The first file you see is suspiciously short, and the page then asks you to do something before it will show you more. Take it slowly; the second version rewards careful reading.
whyItMatters: It's a pillar of the antimemetics thread, the entry where the enemy the Division has been fighting finally gets a description. The page sits inside a tale series and links on to the next story, so it works both as a standalone file and as a chapter. Its central idea, a concept too hostile to be safely thought about, is a high point of the wiki's cosmic horror.
thingsToNotice:
The keypad is the clever part: the public file ends, and the real document appears only after you, like a visitor, effectively step into the room. Comparing the two versions of the procedures shows small but crushing differences, starting with the claim that the anomaly is everywhere except this one room.

The statistics in the history section work as a countdown as the Division shrinks site by site. The addenda then turn the file into letters between people who barely remember each other, ending on stubborn hope rather than resolution.

related.note: Another antimemetic object defined by what you cannot keep in mind.
A text whose danger also spreads through the act of reading it.
